A_team_strength.availability: At least one completed game in an included statistical field; zero games and unavailable sources remain distinct omissions.

B_schedule_venue.availability: Known home/away designation suffices, even when rest is absent. No inferred travel, back-to-back schedule, or tipoff rest.

C_player_availability.availability: At least one non-ambiguous official player status in a timestamp-verified report, or a validated injury/lineup news finding. Submission state and uncertainty retained. Submission/unavailable/ambiguous-only reports skip with reason; unlisted players are not healthy by implication.

D_additional_news.availability: At least one validated nonduplicate finding. Deduplicate normalized team/player/claim, and source-reference plus supported-claim identities; exclude identities already in player-availability news. No semantic invention or reclassification.
